chunks: "The first one whose hair turned gray was Ibrahim al-Khalil عليه السلام. He folded back his beard and saw a white lock, so he said: 'O Jibra'il, what is this?' He said: 'This is dignity.' So Ibrahim said: 'O Allah, increase me in dignity.'"

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْخَلِيلُ: Ibrahim, the intimate friend of Allah
key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنِي وَقَارًا: O Allah, increase me in dignity
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibra'il, the angel addressed in the report
key_terms.طَاقَةً بَيْضَاءَ: a white lock or strand of hair

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the first person to have gray hair and its meaning?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that Ibrahim al-Khalil عليه السلام was the first to become gray-haired, and that he understood this sign through Jibra'il as a mark of dignity. It also highlights Ibrahim’s response of turning to Allah with du'a, asking for an increase in waqar rather than reacting with displeasure.
